description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_AI 예측 강수량 매칭 정보_고정자료 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 본 자료는 AI 홍수예보 시스템에서 AI홍수예측을 위한 인근 강수량지점 정보를 관리하고 홍수특보지점과 강수량 지점 매칭 관계를 제공하는 데이터 항목으로, 관측소와 지점 정보를 포함하여. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are AI 홍수예보 시스템, AI홍수예측, 인근 강수량지점 정보, 홍수특보지점, 강수량지점간 유사 특성. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
